acceptanceCriteria: 复用身份必须由 Runtime 根据实际 target tree、执行器/工具链和影响执行的环境计算或核验；未观测输入不得授权复用；实际环境变化但 JSON 摘要未更新时必须拒绝复用或重新执行。
组合准入必须覆盖声明的 required scenarios、compatibility constraints、composition order、required participants 及传递依赖闭包；必须支持从消费者 feature worktree 指定真实 main target，并拒绝遗漏的必需节点。
verification_required 只能由匹配 Work Item、generation、head、Contract digest 且有效成功的受支持 receipt 满足；说明性文件、空 JSON、过期证据不能通过。MergedTarget 必须核验真实目标分支合并事实。
影响事件登记具备崩溃后重试恢复；按 outcome 过滤同 WI 动作阻塞，并沿三层依赖传播失效。
Outcome 分离临时组合通过与目标真实合并，保留历史通过同时显式标记过期；暂停的 Outcome 与执行准入共享同一决策。
普通单 WI 路径必须继续支持单进程串行生命周期和 canonical verification；没有协作声明或登记时不得要求跨 WI 协调状态。

Publishing an outcome uses explicit CLI and MCP write actions that validate the current registration, generation, outcome identity, and required verification receipt; the appended event binds the exact evidence bytes, read-only inspection does not publish or repair, and stale or mutated evidence cannot satisfy verification_required.
goal: 让运行时从真实仓库与执行事实构造协作准入和复用身份，验证完整依赖与证据要求，保证影响事件可恢复，并使 Outcome 准确表达合并、过期与暂停状态
intent: 修复跨 WI 协作闭环中经独立验收确认的复用身份、必需检查与证据、影响一致性及 Outcome 状态缺口
outOfScope: 不发布、不创建或移动 tag、不升级 Runtime、不改写 WI-1030 历史 Contract/archive/evidence、不扩大到无关协作架构、不修改全局 Agent/MCP 配置或 Provider 资源

scenarioCoverage.description: Runtime-observed execution identity, not caller-declared digest, authorizes reuse.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Changing an observed environment or toolchain input while leaving composition JSON unchanged prevents reuse and re-executes the affected node or fails closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a negative Rust regression and a real CLI/process acceptance that mutates an observed execution input without changing the JSON identity; assert no stale zero-process reuse.

scenarioCoverage.description: Required scenarios, constraints, order, participants, and dependency closure define complete check coverage.
scenarioCoverage.expected: When two checks are required and only one is supplied, composition is rejected before spawning a process.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a Rust negative test and assert zero process starts when one required node is omitted from a two-node declaration.

scenarioCoverage.description: Target refs are resolved from repository facts, not the caller's current branch.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A consumer feature worktree can resolve and compose against the actual main branch and its current SHA without treating the consumer checkout as the target.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a linked-worktree regression with a feature checkout and a distinct main target ref; verify the resolved target SHA and composition base.

scenarioCoverage.description: Explanatory evidence references cannot stand in for verification receipts.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Empty JSON, arbitrary files, failed, stale, or mismatched receipts are rejected; only a supported successful receipt matching Work Item, generation, head, Contract digest, and verification identity satisfies the dependency.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add table-driven negative and positive dependency-admission tests for receipt schema, state, identity, and freshness.

scenarioCoverage.description: Temporary composition success is not target integration.
scenarioCoverage.expected: MergedTarget is denied until the declared target history or supported provider evidence proves the participant is merged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add Git-graph tests for unmerged and truly merged participants, plus a mismatched target receipt negative.

scenarioCoverage.description: The human-facing projection distinguishes temporary composition from actual target merge.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A successful temporary composition with no real target merge reports composition passed and target merge not merged or not observed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add Outcome projection tests where an isolated composition succeeds while the target branch remains unchanged.

scenarioCoverage.description: Latest-by-time alone does not establish current applicability.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The historical successful attempt remains available but current applicability is stale when target/head/Contract identity changes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Persist a successful attempt, advance the target or change current identity, and assert projection retains history while marking it stale.

scenarioCoverage.description: Execution and human-visible state use one refreshed admission decision.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A safely paused current generation is blocked by action admission and shown as blocked in Outcome; unrelated work remains allowed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add projection/admission regression tests for a safely paused target generation and a distinct runnable Work Item.

scenarioCoverage.description: Registration identity changes and invalidation events are recoverable as one logical operation.
scenarioCoverage.expected: An interruption between registration and event persistence followed by an identical registration retry yields exactly one valid impact event and no consumer admission gap.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inject a deterministic storage failure at the registration/event boundary, retry the same registration, and verify idempotent event reconciliation and fail-closed intermediate admission.

scenarioCoverage.description: Dependency blockers are scoped to the action's consumed outcome IDs.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Two actions in one consumer Work Item can name different outcomes; only the action consuming the invalidated outcome is blocked.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Register two outcome dependencies, invalidate one, and assert action-level admission independently for each outcome ID.

scenarioCoverage.description: Impact is evaluated through transitive dependency closure.
scenarioCoverage.expected: An invalidation at the first provider propagates through second- and third-level consumers until the affected chain is explicitly revalidated.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Build a three-level registered dependency graph, publish an invalidation at level one, and verify level two and level three are blocked while an unrelated branch remains allowed.

scenarioCoverage.description: Cross-WI behavior remains opt-in and does not remove ordinary serial execution.
scenarioCoverage.expected: An ordinary single Work Item with no collaboration declaration or coordination records remains able to follow the existing serial lifecycle and canonical verification gate, without waiting for cross-WI state.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a Rust and/or existing process-acceptance regression that exercises the normal single-WI path without coordination state, verifies one-at-a-time execution and successful lifecycle admission, and keeps the canonical Runtime CLI plus Cargo/CI route unchanged.

scope: 仅修复 WI-1030 独立验收列出的事实与复用身份、组合检查覆盖与成果证据、影响登记恢复与按成果准入、Outcome 当前适用性及暂停状态；保留历史档案，新增反例回归和必要文档/CI 映射；在 dedicated worktree 中按协议存储、依赖协调、组合/复用、投影文档串行实施并分审查提交
verification: canonical Runtime CLI/Cargo/CI gate on exact merge candidate
